description: AlpaSim results reported by papers on the same 441-scene NuRec split (e2e challenge nurec_curated_val). Values copied verbatim from the papers' tables; percentages as printed, km per incident converted from metres where the paper reports metres. corridor_exit_pct is the share of scenes leaving the 4 m corridor (ECO prints 'in corridor', converted as 100 - value). Not run by us.
column_mapping_check: ECO's 'VaVAM (nonlin. MPC)' row equals the organizer reference run data/pai/vavam-nonlinear exactly (scene 11.0, at-fault 18.0, off-road 28.0, in-corridor 57.6 = 100 - 42.4 left_corridor_laterally, route progress 42.9 = progress_clipped_rel, 143 m = avg_dist_between_incidents_at_fault 0.1427 km), which fixes the mapping of paper columns to results-summary metrics.

OPTED.citation: Da Col, Igl, Karkus, Chitta, Ivanovic, Pavone, Schindler, Sakaridis. OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher. arXiv 2609.20756 (2026-09-17), Table I
OPTED.setting: 441 held-out NuRec scenes of the public challenge split; 20 s, 10 Hz, non-reactive log replay; commands from the logged trajectory 40 m ahead; default AlpaSim MPC; +- = std over 3 evaluation runs (released checkpoints) or 3 training seeds (fine-tuned); preset / harmonizer not stated

ECO.citation: Zhang, Golchoubian, Gilitschenski, Ivanovic, Chitta. Guiding End-to-End Driving Models with Endpoint-Constrained Trajectory Optimization. arXiv 2609.31383 (2026-09-25), Table III (bottom)
ECO.setting: 441-scene NuRec validation set of the AlpaSim e2e challenge, following OPTED; standard e2e_challenge metrics; nonlinear (default) or linear MPC as labelled; number of rollouts not stated

training_domain_sources.LTFv6, VaVAM, fine-tuning: OPTED Sec. IV-A d,e: LTFv6 pre-trained on nuPlan and CARLA; VaVAM on OpenDV + nuPlan/nuScenes; BC/RoaD-recovery/OPTED train the planning decoder for two epochs on 1669 NuRec training scenes
training_domain_sources.Qwen-Drive 1.0: arXiv 2609.00111 Sec. 2: RL uses 15K NAVSIM navtrain scenes, 15K PhysicalAI-AV scenes and 479 WOD-E2E scenarios
training_domain_sources.Alpamayo: Model cards (Alpamayo-R1-10B, Alpamayo-1.5-10B): training = CoC traces, Cosmos-Reason Physical AI datasets, NVIDIA internal proprietary AV data (80,000 h), plus 'public driving data' for 1.5; PhysicalAI-AV and -NuRec appear as evaluation datasets (also listed in the HF 'datasets' metadata). No card states whether PhysicalAI-AV / NuRec clips were in training. Same vehicle platform and collection programme (25 countries, 2,500+ cities) as PhysicalAI-AV.
training_domain_sources.ECO: arXiv 2609.31383: ECO involves no training; weights chosen on a held-out subset of the HUGSIM train split
